title: Turso contention and request recovery
summary: Keeps replica reads responsive during slow writes, makes activity retries safe against double-counting, and recovers missing request cards without undoing staff reviews.
changes: Separated remote replica reads from the primary write queue so slow Turso writes do not block tracking, tickets, or diagnostics
Batched activity counters and cooldowns atomically with persistent retry receipts to prevent partial updates and double-counting
Drained activity before ranking and shutdown, and postponed weekly winner selection while that week's activity is unconfirmed
Removed idle outbox writes and made historical health sampling yield to interactive database work
Coalesced ticket-cache startup loads and backed off failed retries instead of retrying on every message
Recovered legacy request-message IDs and automatically recreated confirmed missing pending cards with deduplicated sends
Queued validation-card edits durably and guarded delivery against already reviewed or subsequently edited requests
Exposed slow write queues in the dashboard and readiness status, clarified busy errors, and prevented failed schema probes from triggering unnecessary migrations
Added contention, uncertain-commit, cancellation, backup, and request-recovery regression tests and deployment documentation
